why: Intro to Git plan, 'Push the cookbook to GitHub' (passes: origin/main matches the local main branch). The repository was made with a plain `git init`, so its branch is master: `git push -u origin main` failed with 'error: src refspec main does not match any'. The learner then pushed master instead ('[new branch] master -> master', tracking origin/master). GitHub has no main branch and the local branch was never renamed (git branch -M main).

step.title: Send main up to GitHub
step.instructions: Link the empty GitHub repository with git remote add origin git@github.com:<you>/cookbook.git, then send main up and track it with git push -u origin main.
